title: Toluene + ethylbenzene + chlorobenzene selected interior boiling-temperature rows

source.organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), Thermodynamics Research Center
source.name: ThermoML record for Journal of Chemical and Engineering Data 47 (2002) 1324-1329
source.source_table: PureOrMixtureData #8: boiling temperature at total pressure versus liquid mole fractions of toluene and ethylbenzene

transcription: Four published interior rows were selected from the official ThermoML payload. The source reports liquid x(toluene), liquid x(ethylbenzene), total pressure in kPa, and boiling temperature in K; it reports no vapor composition. x(chlorobenzene) is the exact ternary-simplex complement 1 - x(toluene) - x(ethylbenzene). Pressure is converted exactly from kPa to Pa. These values characterize the independent Antoine/Raoult route and must never tune it.

quantities.meaning: published liquid mole fraction of ThermoML component 1, toluene
published liquid mole fraction of ThermoML component 2, ethylbenzene
liquid mole fraction of chlorobenzene inferred only by ternary simplex complement
published boiling temperature at the stated pressure and liquid composition
published expanded uncertainty associated with boiling temperature
